guard: resume holds an unresolved retirement before retained-principal liveness and bypasses presence only for an exact terminal-confirmed predecessor when adopting a different lifecycle
why: The regression enters Manager.resumePreserved through its public method and drives terminal classification through Manager.confirmRetirement, the helper called only from a successful retirement rail reply.
The negative cells keep unresolved holds, unconfirmed outcomes, missing lifecycle UIDs, wrong lifecycle UIDs, and the retired lifecycle itself fail-closed.
